name: start_time
description: The start timestamp of the encounter (UTC).

name: end_time
description: The end timestamp of the encounter (UTC).

name: mean_latitude
description: The mean latitude. Calculated in two stages. First these values are calculated for the raw segments when these values are computed as means over the interpolated points. Second take a weighted average of the averages (by duration of the raw encounters that are being merged) to come up with the average lat/lon for the merged encounter. No guarantee the mean lat/lon will occur along the track.

name: mean_longitude
description: The mean longitude. Calculated in two stages. First these values are calculated for the raw segments when these values are computed as means over the interpolated points. Second take a weighted average of the averages (by duration of the raw encounters that are being merged) to come up with the average lat/lon for the merged encounter. No guarantee the mean lat/lon will occur along the track.

name: median_distance_km
description: The median distance, measured in km.

name: median_speed_knots
description: The median speed, measured in knots.

name: start_lat
description: The beginning latitude where the encounter takes place.

name: start_lon
description: The beginning longitude where the encounter takes place.

name: end_lat
description: The end latitude where the encounter finished.

name: end_lon
description: The end longitude where the encounter finished.
